title: LM Studio server
description: Connect to an LM Studio native v1 server on this machine or another reachable host.

fields.label: Server address
fields.description: Server address, e.g. http://localhost:1234 or http://<mac>.<tailnet>.ts.net:1234. This shared base URL is used by chatBackend and decisionModel. On CodeTerm 1.12.4 and later, remote hosts need a grant from `codeterm plugin settings lmstudio --allow-host <host:port>`.

fields.label: Model fallback
fields.placeholder: leave blank to use the loaded model
fields.description: Fallback model id. A spawn-time model overrides this; matching preset model bindings select prompts and params.

title: Router
description: Providers, model sections and presets are managed in the Router view or with the agent verbs. config.yaml may also declare `providers: [{id, name, kind, baseUrl, apiKeySecret?}]`; those show as read-only.

fields.label: Default provider
fields.description: Provider id used for bare model ids when no LM Studio provider is enabled, and for presets without a provider.

fields.label: Show token usage after each reply
fields.description: Appends input (cached vs fresh) and output token counts when the provider reports them.

fields.title: Declared providers
fields.body: config.yaml may list providers: [{ id, name, kind: openai|anthropic|lmstudio, baseUrl, apiKeySecret? }]. They appear read-only in the Router view. Keys never go in config.yaml.

title: Presets
description: Open-shell presets select the system prompt, model binding, and native LM Studio parameters for new sessions.

fields.label: Default preset
fields.description: Preset id to use when the chosen model has no bound preset and the session does not specify ctx.preset.

fields.title: Preset objects
fields.body: Edit config.yaml for the presets array. Shape: presets: [{ id, name, systemPrompt?, model?, params? }]. A preset with model binds to that exact model id and wins at session init; if it has no systemPrompt, the default preset prompt is used.

title: API key slots
description: Keys live only in this plugin's secret store. Paste a key in the Router view, or pipe it: printf %s "$KEY" | codeterm plugin config lmstudio --secret <slot>. A provider uses <id>_api_key unless it names another slot.
